remarks: Tucked away on a private lane just minutes from downtown, Compo Beach, and Metro-North, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bath expanded Cape offers turnkey living in one of Westport's most desirable locations. Renovated in 2015 with all-new electrical and plumbing, the home has been meticulously maintained with significant recent improvements, including a new roof, furnace, A/C condenser, water heater, and irrigation system. The sun-filled open-concept living, dining, and kitchen spaces are designed for effortless everyday living and entertaining, featuring a wood-burning fireplace, expansive picture windows, and seamless access to a professionally landscaped backyard retreat centered around a charming flagstone patio. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers a large center island, stainless steel appliances, farmhouse sink, instant hot water dispenser, and chimney-style vent hood. A flexible formal dining room with custom built-in bar cabinetry, guest bedroom or home office, and full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features custom California Closets and a spa-inspired bath with marble finishes, soaking tub, double vanity, and glass-enclosed shower. Two additional bedrooms, an updated hall bath, and second-floor laundry complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides versatile living space, while refinished hardwood floors, privacy fencing, and an oversized one-car garage complete this exceptional home!
